fee_notes: Royalty: 6% of Gross Revenue for Start-Up and Refranchise Franchises; Conversion Franchises pay 2% in Year 1, 4% in Year 2, 6% in Year 3+. Royalty paid weekly. Brand Fund Contribution up to 2% of Gross Revenue (currently 1%). Local Marketing required minimum is greater of 6% of Gross Revenue or $32,000/year (8% recommended). Technology Fees: $500/month base (website, 3 Tovuti seats, general tech support) plus $45/month per Office 365 user and $0.55 per NPS survey. Fee increases capped at 10% unless vendor increases exceed 10%.

Royalty Fee 6% of Gross Revenue for Start-Up Franchises and Refranchises; For Conversion Franchises: 2% of Gross Revenue in Year 1, 4% of Gross Revenue in Year 2, and 6% of Gross Revenue in Year 3 and thereafter | Weekly, unless we designate a different period
